name: Day Counter+ v2 (Multiplayer & 24h Time Support)
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: Novz
description: A lightweight modification of the original Day Counter by justwilly, adding full multiplayer support. It displays the current day, player coordinates, and in-game time using a 24-hour format above the hotbar, customizable accent colors and a settings menu.
evidence: Everything its code calls is covered by Kiln 0.4.9 (25 classes, 42 members). Not run yet.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers
